courseTitle: NativeScript + Angular: Build Native iOS, Android & Web Apps

cues.en: With the core basics set, let's now dive into another fundamental concept you got to know when building
native apps, and that is navigation and routing.
So how we can load different pages in our app based on the user interaction.
As it turns out, this works a little bit different than in the Web.
And in this module you will learn how it works and which different options you have.
We'll have a look at well, how navigation works and how it differs from web navigation.
And then we'll dive into specific concepts like using taps or using a side draw.
Also, not just for navigation as a side note.
Now, of course, an important part of navigation, self switching pages is passing data from A to B.
So we'll also have a look at how you can get data from page one to page two.
We'll cover a lot of ground in this module.
So let's lose no time and just dive in.
